title: ExternalAuditFindings
description: Machine-readable tracker for findings from the external security review per SECURITY/external-audit-engagement.md. Populated once the audit report arrives so each finding maps to a public advisory id, a remediation commit, and an embargo state. Empty array is valid (pre-audit state).

bundleVersion.description: Tracker schema version. Bumped only on incompatible shape changes.

auditVendor.description: Vendor that produced the report (e.g., 'Trail of Bits', 'NCC Group'). Omitted pre-vendor-selection.

engagementCommit.description: Full Git SHA of the repo state the audit engaged against. Pinned at kickoff per SECURITY/external-audit-engagement.md §3.

engagementStartedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the audit kickoff occurred.

engagementCompletedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the audit report was delivered. Omitted while in progress.

publicSummaryUrl.description: URL to the public-facing summary of the audit (typically a blog post or PDF). Omitted while embargoed.

findings.description: One entry per finding. Empty array is valid pre-audit. Entries SHOULD be append-only after publication; downgrading or removing a finding requires a CHANGELOG note explaining why.

findingId.description: Stable identifier in the form `OPENWOP-AUDIT-YYYY-NNN` (YYYY = audit year; NNN = serial). The serial is assigned by the steward at intake; once published it MUST NOT change. Distinct from `advisoryId` (the public CVE-style id assigned by the CNA per SECURITY.md, section: Advisory IDs).

severity.description: CVSS-style severity. Critical/high MUST block public publication of high-stakes core packs per `SECURITY/external-audit-engagement.md` §2.1.

status.description: Lifecycle state. `wontfix` requires a documented rationale; `duplicate` requires a `duplicateOf` finding id.

summary.description: One-paragraph summary suitable for the public report. MUST NOT carry exploit details until embargo lifts.

affectedSurfaces.description: Spec / schema / host-impl surfaces the finding touches. E.g., `spec/v1/webhooks.md`, `examples/hosts/postgres/src/pack-consumer.ts`, `SECURITY/threat-model-prompt-injection.md`.

threatModels.description: Threat-model docs this finding lives under. MUST reference at least one when severity is critical/high.

invariantIds.description: Invariant ids from `SECURITY/invariants.yaml` the finding violates or strengthens. Cross-references audit findings to the existing invariant catalog.

remediationCommits.description: Git SHAs of commits that close the finding. Multiple acceptable for findings requiring layered fixes.

advisoryId.description: Public CNA-assigned advisory id when the finding warrants a security advisory (typically critical/high). Format per SECURITY.md §"Advisory IDs". Omitted for findings handled inline without an advisory.

embargoLiftedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the embargo expired and the finding became public. While embargoed, the `summary` MUST stay generic; technical detail lands at lift-time.

duplicateOf.description: When `status === "duplicate"`, the canonical finding id this entry duplicates.

wontfixRationale.description: When `status === "wontfix"`, the documented reason. Audit reviewer countersign-off SHOULD be referenced.
